name: Ramchandra Leasing and Finance Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1998, Ramchandra Leasing and Finance Ltd is doing business as an NBFC
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1][2]
Company is a Non-Banking Financial co doing finance and trading in shares and securities, derivatives, etc. Company is presently classified as Loan Company as it extends unsecured loans to inter corporates and Individual. Company plans to diversify its asset class in money transfer services, foreign currency exchange, remittance services

cons: Stock is trading at 7.25 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -9.33% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 0.30% over last 3 years.
